best: Power paths (3V3 buck, 5 V buck, four-switch stage, pack fuse/back-to-back FET path) are drawn left to right as textbook circuits with titled blocks and one-line notes.
worst: Text collisions around the big ICs: BQ40Z50 left side (R106/FET_MID/CELL_1N, TS2/TS3 labels on thermistors, C118 value on its symbol) and TPS25751 right side (R402/R403/R404 refs over P1_LDO_3V3 labels, C405 on its label, stacked GND pin numbers)

Many small parts hang off IC pins or float tied only by labels (cell-wire connector grid, EEPROM, TVS, TPD6S300, decoupling group, EN_5V pull-down, gauge series resistors with values pushed far from the part), so nets must be chased by name

Uneven use of space: USB sheets are huge with large empty areas and tiny text while the IC neighbourhoods are cramped; long parallel dog-leg wire bundles into the BQ25756 and gauge VC pins are hard to follow
